title: Credit-by-Exam ROI (AP / IB / CLEP)
description: Price which AP, IB, and CLEP exams pay off at a specific college: per exam, the fee plus study hours valued at the user's hourly rate, against the credit grant the user transcribes from the college's policy, valued at the user's tuition rate per credit and weighted by the chance the credit applies to the degree. Exams rank by net dollars with KEEP/DROP calls, per-exam breakeven credits, and keep-vs-drop totals. No policy database is stored; every policy figure is user-transcribed.
data_vintage: Exam fees are editable defaults (typical 2025-26 published per-exam registration fees, not a maintained database). Credit grants, tuition per credit, and approval odds are transcribed by the user from their college's own policy pages; the tool holds no live or refreshable data.

mcp_tool_definition.name: credit_by_exam_roi
mcp_tool_definition.description: Rank AP/IB/CLEP exams by expected net return at a specific college: per exam, fee plus study hours valued at an hourly rate, versus the credit grant times tuition per credit, weighted by the probability the credit applies to the degree. Returns a ranked table with KEEP/DROP calls, breakeven credits, and keep-vs-drop totals.
